title: Technology acceptance, chatbot usability, and cognitive load of secondary school students in the SMOKEChem pilot study (Version 1)
note: Worked 2026-10-21d -> 3 tables, 4,420 responses. leppla_2026_smokechem_{bot_usability,acceptance,cognitive_load}: 130 German tenth-graders rating the SMOKEChem learning environment, CC BY 4.0, with all 34 item stems in German and English in the workbook's own Items sheet.
